item_name: Non-invasive Mechanical Ventilator (including BiPAP and CPAP sub-items G2, G3)

lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: The assessor observation window differs by column. Column b (While a Resident) uses the last 14 days after admission/entry or reentry — recorded here as lookback_days = 14. Column a (On Admission) uses days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B (p. O-3, p. O-1). Column c (At Discharge) uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C (p. O-3, p. O-1). Note that the printed item table on p. O-1 provides column b check boxes only for G1; G2 (BiPAP) and G3 (CPAP) have check boxes only in columns a and c.

coding_levels.label: Non-invasive Mechanical Ventilator — While a Resident

coding_levels.label: BiPAP

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code any type of CPAP or BiPAP respiratory support device that prevents airways from closing by delivering slightly pressurized air through a mask or other device continuously or via electronic cycling throughout the breathing cycle.

source.quote: Code any type of CPAP or BiPAP respiratory support devices that prevent airways from closing by delivering slightly pressurized air through a mask or other device continuously or via electronic cycling throughout the breathing cycle.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If a ventilator or respirator is being used as a substitute for BiPAP/CPAP, code it here (in O0110G1) rather than as an invasive mechanical ventilator.

source.quote: If a ventilator or respirator is being used as a substitute for BiPAP/CPAP, code here.

federal_coding_rules.rule: This item may be coded if the resident places or removes their own BiPAP/CPAP mask/device.

source.quote: This item may be coded if the resident places or removes their own BiPAP/CPAP mask/device.

federal_coding_rules.rule: O0110G2, BiPAP: check if the non-invasive mechanical ventilator support was BiPAP.

source.quote: Check if the non-invasive mechanical ventilator support was BiPAP.

federal_coding_rules.rule: O0110G3, CPAP: check if the non-invasive mechanical ventilator support was CPAP.

source.quote: Check if the non-invasive mechanical ventilator support was CPAP.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column a (On Admission): check the item if it was received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; if nothing was received or performed in that 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column b (While a Resident): check the item if it was received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days; if nothing was received or performed within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column c (At Discharge): check the item if it was received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C; if nothing was received or performed in that 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

source.quote: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators; surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

source.quote: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators. Surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not code O0110F1 (Invasive Mechanical Ventilator) when the ventilator or respirator is used only as a substitute for BiPAP or CPAP (such use is coded under O0110G1 instead).

source.quote: Do not code this item when the ventilator or respirator is used only as a substitute for BiPAP or CPAP.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed the treatment/procedure/program within the assessment period defined for each column.

source.quote: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

federal.notes: Stated as Step 1 for assessment of O0110; the medical record is the stated evidence source.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages define the On Admission and At Discharge windows in relation to the SNF PPS Stay (A2400B/A2400C) but do not state that O0110G is used in any payment or case-mix classification.

conflicts.topic: Multiple assessment windows coexist for O0110G (3-day admission window, 14-day while-a-resident window, 3-day discharge window)

conflicts.resolution: Resolved by the document itself: each column has its own stated assessment period; the 14-day window applies to column b (While a Resident) and is recorded as lookback_days.
